sentences.en: In the - end the estates of the houses of Lancaster, Kent, Bohun, Burgh and Mortimer swelled the revenues of Edward's children and grandchildren; in whose favour also the new title of duke was introduced.

sentences.en: In 1894 the queen stayed for some weeks at Florence, and on her return she stopped at Coburg to witness the marriage between two of her grandchildren, the grand duke of Hesse and the Princess Victoria Melita of Coburg.
sentences.vi: Năm 1894, nữ hoàng ở lại Florence vài tuần, và khi trở về, bà dừng lại ở Coburg để chứng kiến hôn lễ giữa hai người cháu của mình, đại công tước xứ Hesse và công chúa Victoria Melita của Coburg.

sentences.en: When he resigned the chancellorship he called his children and grandchildren together to explain his reduced circumstances.

sentences.en: His posterity included several famous names, those of his grandchildren.
